product_metadata.title: GXQQ Stripe Boho Throw Blankets for Couch, Lightweight Farmhouse Luxury Sherpa Blanket, Super Soft & Cozy Flannel Throw Blanket for Bed Sofa Couch 50”x60”
features: BLANKET DESIGN -- Our bohemian throw blanket used native American style design, couch blanket is print only one side, and environmental printing dyeing doesn’t shed, not fuzz balls.
MATERIAL -- Sherpa flannel blankets made of polyester flannel material, it is super soft and skin-friendly, delicate and smooth, which offer relaxing warmth and coziness.

SOFT & COZY -- The flannel throw blanket super comfortable and soft, the blanket keeps you warm and comfy which daily use when watching TV, reading on a couch, relaxing a chair or a bed. Great for indoor or outdoor use.
BLANKET SIZE -- 50x60 inches stripe throw blanket lightweight and durable. This size bohemian throw blanket perfect fit adult, teenager and kids, also, Couch blanket a practical value gift.

EASY CARE -- Our fleece throw blanket is easy to clean. Hand wash or machine wash with cold water separately on a gentle or delicate cycle. (Don’t Direct Heat. Don’t Bleach). Not pilling after washing.
